# Captured with opencode-ai 1.18.30 for the six legacy menu selections.
# The empty auto result has no login URL or instructions. Its failed callback
# means no sign-in occurred, not that the menu action failed. This prevents
# OpenCode from treating a newly added fallback as its main login.
# Command shape: opencode auth login --provider <fixture> --method <fixture>

exit_code=0
